propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' on Python 3.11 during test_matching_guard_is_accepted teardown, blocking CI matrix jobs with spurious Verified -1

asyncio.wait_for on Python 3.11 consumes external cancellation when child task completes in same event-loop turn, leaving worker parked at queue.get() with cancelling()==1 while lifespan awaits forever
Replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout) with async with asyncio.timeout(...): await asyncio.to_thread(...) restores correct cancellation semantics and prevents worker hang
Defect is Python 3.11-specific; Python 3.12+ unaffected due to fixed cancellation handling in asyncio
Flake is reproducible locally under high CPU/memory contention across concurrent suite runs, not just in CI
